name: The Hidden Cults of Lost Lust
source:
Welcome to a world once devistated by the powers of a fell cult. Now that the world has ended it's up to the Catalyst Research Group to put the missing pieces together and restore order. However, the cults may not be quite as gone as once thought to be.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-hidden-cults-of-lost-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
